roleContext.jobDescription: A domestic-appliance manufacturer builds the control boards for its washing machines and dryers in house. The embedded software engineer writes C for the board microcontrollers, keeps unit and hardware-in-the-loop tests up to date, helps the hardware engineers bring up new boards and follows the IEC 60730 safety process. The next washer platform needs an engineer who has led the firmware for a product platform, owning its architecture and the release decisions. The firmware team has seven engineers, a platform lead and a quality engineer, and every firmware release needs approval under the company's release procedure.

requirements.text: Develops embedded C for microcontroller-based appliance control boards.

Has led the firmware for a product platform, owning the architecture and release decisions.
Supports hardware engineers during board bring-up.
Follows the IEC 60730 class B safety process for software modules.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Embedded Software Engineer, Appliance Controls

## Experience

- Embedded software engineer at Ridgeway Appliances from January 2020 to February 2024, in the laundry-controls firmware team of seven, working on washing-machine and dryer control boards.
- Wrote the motor-control state machine and the door-lock driver in C for the 2023 washing-machine control board, following the firmware architecture set by the platform lead.
- Added unit tests with Unity and Ceedling and ran the hardware-in-the-loop regression suite on every firmware candidate, recording failures in the defect tracker.
- According to my department manager I was 'the firmware lead for the whole washer platform in practice' and 'made the release calls'.
- Supported the hardware engineers during board bring-up, writing test firmware to exercise the sensors and the motor driver on the first prototype boards.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the door-lock driver module with its unit tests and the IEC 60730 class B self-test checklist that the candidate completed and the platform lead reviewed.
